symptoms: Continuous seizure activity >= 5 minutes OR recurrent seizures without interval recovery

management_steps.details: Lorazepam 0.1 mg/kg IV (max 2mg/min), Diazepam 0.2-0.3 mg/kg IV (max 5mg/min), Clonazepam 0.02 mg/kg IV, OR Midazolam 0.2 mg/kg IV / 0.3 mg/kg buccal/IN. Repeat 2nd dose if needed.
Phenytoin 20 mg/kg IV (max 50 mg/min), Sodium Valproate 20-30 mg/kg IV (3-6 mg/kg/min), OR Phenobarbitone 20 mg/kg IV. Repeat half dose after 20 min if seizing.

Midazolam: 0.2 mg/kg IV load, then 0.1 mg/kg/hr infusion.
Propofol: 3-5 mg/kg IV load, then 1-15 mg/kg/hr infusion.
Ketamine: 1.5 mg/kg IV load, then 0.01-0.05 mg/kg/hr infusion.
